title: Mask Adoption Dynamics
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and comply with face mask usage over time under social influence, information exposure, policy mandates, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask usage among their social contacts and update their adoption decision via peer influence or social norms.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask requirements; noncompliant individuals may be denied entry or fined, affecting future compliance.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: People consume messages from Authority and MediaChannel that shift risk perception and intention to adopt masks.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People acquire masks from suppliers; availability and price constrain adoption.

interactions.name: mobility_and_contact
interactions.description: People move among locations and interact, creating opportunities for social influence and policy compliance checks.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of people wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of people wearing masks at the end of the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of location entries where individuals complied with mask requirements.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in mask adoption across socioeconomic groups (e.g., Gini or variance).

metrics.name: mask_availability
metrics.description: Average mask stock per capita over time or frequency of stockouts.

metrics.name: message_reach
metrics.description: Fraction of the population exposed to Authority/Media messages per time step.
